question: GQ-009
subject: the corrected decisions were invisible on the only channel that reaches Shaan

the_gap.page_did_not_show: Any of the five headlines, all of which I had just spent four loops correcting
the_gap.where_they_were: Inside the raw snapshot JSON dump at the bottom of the page
the_gap.test: Split index.html at "Raw snapshot": "12-95% saving" appeared ONLY after the split point.

why_it_matters: Zero working push routes. The observatory is the only channel that reaches Shaan, and it was reporting a count of things I had corrected without showing what they now say. He would read "5" and learn nothing about the 4.68 GB/day, the 3.7% scope fix, or the want-list that resolved decision 7.
the_fix: A "Decisions waiting on you" section listing each headline, mirroring the escalations section.

verified_both_ways.with_5_open: section renders with all five headlines

this_is_the_second_instance: Two loops ago I found the same defect for escalations: the page showed "3 queued" and none of their content. I fixed escalations and did not check the adjacent feature, which had the identical shape — a count rendered, the content buried in JSON.
